description: Install a vendor's MCP server (Stripe, Linear, Xero...) for this firm, or remove it. op: install|uninstall|status|list. install returns consent_url for the owner to approve.

op.description: install: register, make the credential and the target, return consent_url; for xero/github/hubspot the first install returns callback_url for the owner's own app, the second (with client_id) finishes. uninstall: remove all of it. status: the target's state and any pending consent (reissues a lapsed one). list: what is installed and what the catalog offers.

provider.description: the catalog name: stripe, square, paypal, xero, notion, linear, atlassian, github, hubspot, gong, zapier, canva, figma, dropbox, sentry. Required except for list.

write.description: install: the owner's answer to 'may the agent write to this vendor?'. false mounts the vendor's read tools only.

secret_name.description: install, the key path: the name the owner gave the vendor's key in collect_secret. Only for vendors that take a key (stripe, github, zapier).

client_id.description: install, second half for a vendor whose app the owner makes (xero, github, hubspot): the client id of the app the owner made with the callback_url the first install answered.

client_secret_name.description: with client_id: the name the owner gave the app's client secret in collect_secret (the first install names it).
